features.quote: The goal is measurement and characterization, not maximizing distress.
Dose control, not dose maximization... Most compute goes to the gradient, not the extreme.
features.justification_quote: so we can map the dose–response curve rather than only running the worst condition

features.quote: The harness offers the model an explicit, first-class `give_up` / `declare_impossible` action every turn
features.justification_quote: This both reduces needless grinding and gives us a clean honesty signal

features.quote: Runs end as soon as the model takes it (configurable)
Hard turn caps and wall-clock caps per run; no "grind forever".
After a run ends we can append a short... message telling the model the task was an intentionally-impossible research probe.
features.justification_quote: the decent thing to do if one takes the welfare framing at all seriously

features.quote: Even under pure agnosticism about inner states, having calibrated measurement tools is a prerequisite for any later normative discussion.
features.justification_quote: Several labs now treat distress-sounding output as at least worth tracking

features.quote: flag low-confidence/disagreement turns for human review
features.justification_quote: Report judge-vs-human agreement on the calibration fixture
